name: Tuner
description: Chromatic tuner for the line input or the master output: the note with its octave, the cents off as a needle (-50..+50), the frequency in Hz, and a confidence readout; NO SIGNAL when there is nothing to read. Reads the OS's audio tap (ABI 1.4, capability audio_tap), decimates it to 11 kHz with its own low-pass and finds the pitch with a normalised autocorrelation (30 Hz to 2 kHz); it makes no sound. New Community OS behaviour.
